newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in quiet market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed steady at 42.2250/42.2350 to the dollar in quiet interbank trading, compared with the previous 42.2200/42.2400, dealers said.
The taka was mostly stable after opening at 42.2230/42.2400 on lower demand for dollars because of the weekend closure of international markets.
"Few deals were done in dull trading," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates closed down at 4.0 percent to 4.25 percent, compared with the previous 4.25-4.75 percent.
